qa.note: The Energy Information Project's Oil and Gas Watch lists Morgan Valley under the same facility record that GEM uses for Fairfax, which is why it shows proposed. The Corridor Business Journal article of March 5, 2026 says the Fairfax proposal was dropped and Morgan Valley is a new proposal at another site. The same reporting gives Morgan Valley as three combustion turbines of about 720 MW, against two 425 MW units at Fairfax. The month or year of the drop is not stated in that article. The existing source dated October 2025 says deprioritized, and that page now returns a 404 error.

qa.recommendation: Treat Fairfax and Morgan Valley as separate entries. Fairfax is the dropped first proposal. Morgan Valley is the replacement, so a reviewer may want to link them in the notes.
qa.note: Both are Alliant projects near Fairfax in Linn County. The sites differ and the sizes differ. I did not find a document that calls Morgan Valley the same project as Fairfax. The Sierra Club list showing Unit 2 as planned most likely reflects Morgan Valley.
